title: Intermittent p95 latency regression on checkout-service
description: Monitoring shows intermittent p95 latency spikes on checkout-service without a matching error-rate increase. Candidate causes include GC pause growth, database connection pool exhaustion, and a noisy-neighbor workload on the same node. No known deterministic pattern matches, so the incident is intended to exercise remote model (Microsoft Foundry) reasoning in Shadow or RemoteModel mode.
